headline: Western Digital (WDC) Could Be 66% Overvalued On Earnings Week Optimism
summary: Western Digital (WDC) is in focus ahead of its fiscal fourth quarter earnings report on August 5, with investors watching how AI driven data center demand and high capacity hard disk drives are feeding into recent stock moves. See our latest analysis for Western Digital. Western Digital has seen strong momentum ahead of earnings, with a 7 day share price return of 18.73% and a 90 day share price return of 18.25%. Its 1 year total shareholder return is very large and reflects intense interest...
